PC: IF the student asks why you are wearing sunglasses.
IF the learner asks about how you got the bruise under your (left) eye.
IF the learner asks “Do you have any other injuries that you would like me to evaluate today?”
SBP: Provide patient with support and resources as needed.
IF the learner asks “Do you feel safe going home from here”? “Are you and children safe where you are currently living?”
ICS: Discuss results of urinalysis with patient.

A Framing Question the student may ask: “Because violence is so common in the patients I see, I ask all my patients this question” or “This pattern of injury is often caused by another person, did someone hurt you?”
Only take off your sunglasses if student asks in a respectful (compassionate) way.
IF the learner asks “Has your partner ever hit you or physically hurt you in the past?”
